clips.text: Who opened this while I was gone?
Before anyone says anything, I respect privacy.
That's a very specific opening statement.
I left you two alone for one whole minute.
I stayed here. Benny left for water, then came back.
Which proves I was busy doing something completely normal.
You both had time. Did anybody else come in?
No. Just us.
Cherry has scissors. Case closed.
For my snack bag.
That's exactly what somebody with scissors would say.
This wasn't a clean cut. Somebody pulled it apart.
Thank you.
Could've been a very determined breeze.
With the windows shut?
An indoor breeze. Rare, but ambitious.
And your pocket has the missing piece.
That's... decorative.
It fits exactly.
I wanted to know if you'd remembered my birthday.
It's tomorrow. I remembered.
Next time, wrap your evidence too.
